entry.title: New: Resolution 235 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
CREATES ONE NEW BATTALION CHIEF AND THREE NEW FIRE HELICOPTER PILOT POSITIONS FOR THE HAWAI‘I COUNTY FIRE DEPARTMENT

Establishes new pilot positions necessary to transition away from contracting services and adds a Battalion Chief position for the Emergency Operations Division.

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 235-23 & FC-69 - 09/20/23
